title: Singapore Highlights with Sentosa and the Gardens
alt: Cable car cabins crossing the harbour towards Sentosa island in Singapore
transport: Private airport transfers with shared coaches for tours and tickets

expert.name: Nisha Rao
expert.quote: This is the order I give first time visitors. Sentosa early while energy is high, the city and the Gardens at the end.
expert.tip: Give yourself two hours at Jewel on the way out. The waterfall and the canopy park sit inside the airport, so you lose nothing from the trip.

summary: Five days of the headline sights. The cable car, oceanarium and Wings of Time on Sentosa, a full day at Universal Studios, then the city tour with Gardens by the Bay and the Marina Bay Sands SkyPark.
included: Included: 4 nights at the Holiday Inn Express Novena with daily breakfast; two way cable car sky pass; Singapore Oceanarium; Wings of Time; Universal Studios one day pass; half day city tour; Gardens by the Bay with Cloud Forest and Jurassic World; Marina Bay Sands SkyPark; 9 private and shared transfers.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; lunches and dinners; attractions not named above; personal expenses.

day_titles.2: Cable car, oceanarium and Wings of Time
day_titles.4: City tour, Gardens and the SkyPark

1: Arrival at Changi Airport and private sedan transfer to Novena
Time at Jewel on the way out of the terminal for the Rain Vortex
Check in and keep the first evening free
Optional: supper at a hawker centre near Novena MRT
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Mount Faber for the cable car
Two way sky pass with the harbour and the container port below
Singapore Oceanarium on Sentosa with its open ocean tank
Wings of Time on Siloso beach once the sun is down
3: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Resorts World Sentosa
One day pass for Universal Studios across all seven zones
Shows and coasters through the afternoon at your own pace
Evening free for the Sentosa boardwalk or VivoCity
4: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the half day city tour
Merlion Park, Marina Bay, Chinatown and the civic district
Cloud Forest and the Jurassic World trail at Gardens by the Bay
Marina Bay Sands SkyPark on level 57 for the last view of the city
5: Private sedan transfer to Changi Airport for your flight home

program.name: The headline sights in order
program.description: Four nights in Novena with Sentosa at the start, a theme park day in the middle and the city skyline saved for the end.

activities.name: Singapore Cable Car Sky Pass
activities.description: A two way ride from Mount Faber over HarbourFront to Sentosa, with the port and the islands below.

activities.name: Singapore Oceanarium
activities.description: Sentosa's rebuilt aquarium with an open ocean tank, reef galleries and a research wing for the children.

activities.name: Wings of Time
activities.description: A twenty minute night show on the beachfront built from water jets, lasers, fire and a short film.

activities.name: Universal Studios Singapore
activities.description: A one day pass covering Sci Fi City, Ancient Egypt, Far Far Away and the Hollywood boulevard shows.

activities.name: Half Day Singapore City Tour
activities.description: A shared coach tour past Merlion Park, Marina Bay, the Helix bridge, Chinatown and the old civic quarter.

activities.name: Gardens by the Bay
activities.description: The Cloud Forest dome with its indoor waterfall and the Jurassic World trail among the Supertrees.

activities.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
activities.description: The observation deck on level 57, straight above the bay, the Gardens and the financial district.

activities.name: Singapore Flyer
activities.description: A slow turn on the observation wheel beside Marina Bay, with the Strait and the skyline in one sweep.
